t: This Magnusson organiser offers robust, secure storage for small parts and micro-equipment, essential for trade professionals and DIY enthusiasts. Its impact-resistant plastic construction and clear hinged lid with secure plastic clamps ensure contents are protected, and preventing migration during transport. Featuring two large and eight small removable organiser bins, it allows for customisable arrangement of screws, fixings, electrical connectors, and other components. The practical folding collapsible handle makes it easy to carry, and the strong interlocking latches allows stacking of multiple organisers. Provides efficient, space-saving storage in workshops, vans, or garages.
b: 2 x Large & 8 x Small Organiser Bins
